channel.title: Orbi Blog
channel.description: Notes from shipping Orbi in the open: delivery runs, failures, fixes, and measurements.

item.title: Rejected, fixed, merged: Orbi in a k8s distro
item.description: An etcd test suite Orbi wrote for k8e, a 497-star Kubernetes distro, came back REQUEST_CHANGES. What the review caught, what Orbi fixed, and what it got wrong.

item.title: Designing one slash command
item.description: Naming, syntax, regex anchoring, registry shape: four tradeoffs behind one in-ticket command, read against Prow and bors-ng at source, with line numbers.

item.title: Waiting for an answer the user can't give
item.description: Our engine paused for a human decision, then accepted only an answer the tenant could not give. Three versions of that mistake, found in one afternoon.

item.title: Watch the seven steps, start to finish
item.description: An 83-second video follows the real Orbi Cloud setup from GitHub sign-in to a tagged release and subscription. The seventh step starts paid delivery for Cloud.

item.title: An autonomous coding agent that can tell itself no
item.description: Most autonomous coding agents stop at a pull request. This delivery shows a second model refusing the diff twice, with commits and a release you can inspect.

item.title: Claude Code in Actions: who merges?
item.description: Claude Code Action implements and reviews pull requests in your runner, but it does not merge or release. This is the evidence-backed path that closes the gap.

item.title: Docker image published on the third try
item.description: The orbi image reached GHCR and Docker Hub on the third publish run. Three earlier failures came from build context, Dockerfile paths, and an invalid image tag.
